tenant_context.authorization.capability_ids contains company_authority_v1 at the exact path.
RFC8785 JCS, UTF-8, detached Ed25519 JWS, TTL, audience, and protected header are fixed.
auto, approval, human_action, and deny each have deterministic positive coverage.

ObservedExecutionRequestV1 rejects each resolved person/org/project/owner/RACI/approver/decision/policy/credential field in both schema and reference validation; human_action remains pending until completion and deny effect counters remain zero.

Trusted kid-to-key resolution, key rotation, and key revocation are runtime non-goals; the reference validator is non-authoritative and production cutover is blocked pending separately verified runtime trust and consumer enforcement.
No runtime or production action is performed.
